coastal_forecast.datum: NOAA model sea-level datum; do not subtract HKO/CWA/JMA tide-table datums
coastal_forecast.limitations: Regional model guidance, not an official local warning or wave-runup/total-inundation forecast. Grid is about 10 km; point distance is retained. Keep the model residual separate from official astronomical tide tables.

snow_probability_inputs.method: 06:00: fraction of all 51 members with >0 cm snow accumulated within the exact 24h window. Retain the threshold/denominator. Do not infer this from rain probability.

astronomical_tide.note: Public CWA product provides exact high/low events; no hourly astronomical series has been validated.

hourly_reference.datum: CWA station reference; retain separately from town-level chart/TWVD/MSL event heights
hourly_reference.note: Retained reference series only; no computed product reads it. Taipei's tide product is the official CWA high/low event table above.

local_coastal_forecast.note: astron_tide is astronomical tide; surge is the forecast coastal water level, not itself a residual. Preserve the common station reference.
